tooltip.etheris.vigia_contract: Clear floor + Chamber proof + 60 Ether. One Sentinel per player.
tooltip.etheris.vigia_release: Sneak + use in air releases the old bond without a refund.
message.etheris.vigia.released: Bond released. The old Sentinel will disappear when loaded, without refunding materials.
message.etheris.vigia.not_owner: This Sentinel only answers to its creator.
message.etheris.vigia.space: Use the contract on solid ground, with clear space and no liquids.
message.etheris.vigia.proof: Record the Proof of Transmutation before creating a Sentinel.
message.etheris.vigia.limit: You already have a bound Sentinel, even if it is in another region.
message.etheris.vigia.energy: Creating a Sentinel requires 60 inner Ether.
message.etheris.vigia.created: Sentinel bound! Empty hand cycles orders; Fragments refuel. Sneak to inspect.
advancement.etheris.chamber.title: A Project in Matter
advancement.etheris.chamber.description: Craft a Chamber. Build a 3×3 polished deepslate base, amethyst corners and cut copper sides.
